---
title: "JSXDrawing in Quarto"
format:
  html:
    css: jsxdrawing.min.css
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script src="jsxdrawing.min.js"></script>
---

Render with `quarto preview example.qmd` from this folder (so
`jsxdrawing.min.js`, `jsxdrawing.min.css` and `question1.json` sit next to it).

## Question 1 (props from a JSON file)

```{=html}
<div data-drawing-app data-props-src="question1.json"></div>
```

## Question 2 (inline props)

```{=html}
<div data-drawing-app>
  <script type="application/json">
    {
      "questionText": "Draw the budget line for income 80 and prices of 10 for both goods.",
      "boundingBox": [-1, 11, -1, 11],
      "width": 600,
      "height": 600,
      "enabledTools": ["select", "segment", "eraser"],
      "expectedDrawing": [{ "type": "segment", "yIntercept": 8, "slope": -1, "tolerance": 0.1 }]
    }
  </script>
</div>
```
